versions.changelog:
- Initial release of a comprehensive knowledge base covering Floods' business model, product mechanics, pricing, verification, attribution, brand safety, and differentiation from influencer marketing.
- Includes detailed explanations of the 3-step campaign process, CPM-based pricing model, and robust three-layer impression verification system.
- Outlines dual attribution approach (link-in-bio plus organic lift), client brand safety controls, and campaign setup timeline.
- Provides clear comparison vs. influencer marketing and operational facts such as platform partners, impression volumes, and compliance.
- Designed to trigger on any questions or references related to Floods’ product, pricing, or competitive positioning in pitches or client discussions.
